local_episode_grouping.reason: JMA detection rows are approximately 10-minute observations; 20 minutes permits one missing cycle without merging longer discontinuities.
local_episode_grouping.cross_subdivision_reason: Do not invent spatial event linkage before a validated historical precipitation/object field is available.

temporal_splits.model_use: retrospective stress test only; never call final holdout

boundary_embargo_semantics: Any anchor within +/- 6 hours of a split boundary is assigned BOUNDARY_EMBARGO and excluded from model fitting/evaluation to prevent a meteorological episode from straddling splits.
retrospective_2026_reason: 2026 observations and live cases have already informed system architecture and feature engineering, so pre-freeze 2026 data cannot honestly be labeled untouched final holdout.
